mapper.select: SELECT fsr.bp_id, fsr.SCORE_USER_ID, fsr.CREATED_BY, ( SELECT a.ALLOCATION_ID FROM sys_user_allocation a WHERE a.user_id = fsr.score_user_id ) allocation_id, ( SELECT b.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master b WHERE b.bp_id = fsr.bp_id ) bp_name, max(fsr.to_date) max_to_date FROM hls_score_calculation fsr where fsr.GRADE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY fsr.bp_id

SELECT fsr.* FROM hls_score_calculation fsr
fsr.GRADE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' and fsr.bp_id = #{bpId} and to_char(fsr.score_date,'yyyy') = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy')

select t.* from hls_score_calculation t
1=1 and t.bp_id = #{bpId} and to_char(t.score_date, 'yyyymmdd') = to_char(#{maxToDate}, 'yyyymmdd') and to_char(t.score_date, 'yyyymmdd') = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyymmdd')

select fsr.* from hls_score_calculation fsr
1=1 and to_char(fsr.SCORE_DATE, 'yyyy') = to_char(#{scoreDate}, 'yyyy') and fsr.GRADE_STATUS in ('APPROVING','APPROVED') and fsr.bp_id = (select distinct t.bp_id from hls_score_calculation t where t.score_id = #{scoreId} )

select fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID, fsr.SCORE_ID, fsr.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID, fsr.SCORE_DATE, fsr.FISCAL_YEAR, fsr.RESULT_ID, fsr.IS_TURN_UP, fsr.bp_id, fsr.GRADE_STATUS, fsr.FINANCIAL_FLAG, fsr.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID, (select fsr1.SCORE_VALUE from fnd_score_result fsr1 where fsr1.SCORE_RESULT_ID = fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID) SCORE_VALUE, (select fsr1.SCORE_GRADE from fnd_score_result fsr1 where fsr1.SCORE_RESULT_ID = fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID) SCORE_GRADE,
( select DISTINCT hfsh.FISCAL_YEAR value_name from hls_fin_statement_hd hfsh where hfsh.FISCAL_YEAR = fsr.FISCAL_YEAR ) FISCAL_YEAR_N,
( SELECT scvb.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID AND scb.CODE = 'GREAD.FINAL_SCORE_GRADE' AND scvb.VALUE = ( select fsr1.SCORE_GRADE from fnd_score_result fsr1 where fsr1.SCORE_RESULT_ID = fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID ) ) SCORE_GRADE_N,
( SELECT scvb.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID AND scb.CODE = 'GREAD.FINAL_SCORE_GRADE' AND scvb.VALUE = nvl(fsr.FINAL_SCORE_GRADE,( select fsr1.SCORE_GRADE from fnd_score_result fsr1 where fsr1.SCORE_RESULT_ID = fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID )) ) FINAL_SCORE_GRADE_N,
( SELECT scvb.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID AND scb.CODE = 'GRADE.GRADE_STATUS' AND scvb.VALUE = fsr.GRADE_STATUS ) GRADE_STATUS_N,
(select hbm.BP_NAME from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.BP_ID = fsr.BP_ID) BP_NAME_N,
(select fsth.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_NAME value_name from fnd_score_template_hd fsth where fsth.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID = fsr.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID) SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID_N,
( select hfsh.FISCAL_MONTH value_name from hls_fin_statement_hd hfsh where hfsh.FIN_STATEMENT_HD_ID = fsr.FISCAL_MONTH ) FISCAL_MONTH_N,
( SELECT hr.FIN_STATEMENT_NAME FROM hls_bp_financial_header h, hls_web_excel_calc_result hr, hls_web_excel hwe WHERE h.header_id = hr.source_document_id AND hr.source_document_category = 'FINANCIAL_REPORT' AND hwe.excel_id = hr.excel_id and hr.RESULT_ID = fsr.RESULT_ID AND h.bp_id = fsr.bp_id ) RESULT_ID_N, fsr.*, (select scvb.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID and scb.CODE = 'GRADE.IS_TURN_UP' and scvb.VALUE = fsr.IS_TURN_UP) IS_TURN_UP_N, fsr.RISK_WARNING_ID, (select prw.RISK_WARNING_NUMBER from plm_risk_warning prw where prw.RISK_WARNING_ID = fsr.RISK_WARNING_ID) RISK_WARNING_ID_N
from hls_score_calculation fsr
1=1
and fsr.bp_id = #{bpId}
and fsr.SCORE_DATE = #{scoreDate}
and fsr.GRADE_STATUS = #{gradeStatus}
and fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID in ( select fsr1.SCORE_RESULT_ID from fnd_score_result fsr1 where fsr1.SCORE_GRADE = #{finalScoreGrade} )
and fsr.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID = #{scoreTemplateHdId}
and fsr.SCORE_ID = #{scoreId}
order by fsr.SCORE_ID desc
